merits.for_arg: Satellite imagery, circumnavigation by sea and air, ships vanishing hull-first over the horizon, lunar eclipse shadows that are always round, and consistent time zones all point to a sphere. Every independent line of evidence converges.
merits.against_arg: It looks flat when I stand in a field, so I am not convinced.
merits.reason: The FOR argument provides multiple independent, verifiable lines of empirical evidence that converge on sphericity, while the AGAINST argument relies solely on subjective visual perception from a single vantage point without addressing the evidence presented.
